integrity: The lower bound is proved by an exact order-statistic decomposition showing that below two tail masses Expected Shortfall is either the fixed maximum or an increasing affine function of VaR. Sharpness is witnessed by two equal-mean, equal-maximum empirical loss vectors, and a standalone exact-rational replay verifies representative rational confidence levels including 95% and 97.5%.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equally weighted empirical nonnegative losses under the left-quantile VaR and integrated-quantile Expected Shortfall convention. It assumes matched scenario count, mean loss, and maximum loss; other quantile interpolation rules or unequal scenario weights require separate treatment.
title: Matched mean and worst loss delay VaR–Expected-Shortfall reversal to two tail masses
